choices.name: Icyenic Faith
effects: Grants the Tome of the Icyene.
When worn, the Tome of the Icyene provides +50 Prayer bonus.
When worn, the Tome of the Icyene provides 0.2% critical strike chance per 1 Prayer bonus.
When worn, the Tome of the Icyene provides 0.2% base ability damage per 1 Prayer bonus.
Protection prayers and deflection curses block 100% of damage.
Protection prayers and deflection curses act as Soul Split being active.

choices.name: Naragi Edict
effects: When worn, the Sliver of Edicts provides +300 Armour.
When worn, the Sliver of Edicts provides +14 Melee, Ranged, Magic, and Necromancy damage bonus.
When worn, the Sliver of Edicts provides +1,500 maximum life points.
When worn, the Sliver of Edicts provides +15 Prayer bonus.
While active: heals 10,000 life points four times (every 4.2 seconds).
While active: combat levels set to 255.
While active: revives the player once if they die.

reason: Tier 7: keep Icyenic Faith seat 0; add Naragi Edict seat 1 (wiki effects; product seat 1). Wiki lists tier as unknown, so verified stays false.
